verdicts.delivered: So far: H1 FY27 EBIT margin 24.0% vs 26–28% guided for FY27 — behind

bull: Revenue growth accelerated to 11.2% YoY in Q2 FY27 from 2.4% in Q2 FY26.
PAT growth reached 14.9% YoY in Q2 FY27, the highest in the last nine quarters.
Consumer Business segment margins expanded to 29.8% in Q2 FY27 from 27.7% in Q2 FY26.
bear: EBIT margin of 24.0% in H1 FY27 is significantly below management's 26-28% long-term target.
EBITDA margin contracted to 25.7% in H1 FY27 from 27.0% in H1 FY26.
Manufacturing segment margins declined to 27.8% in Q2 FY27 from 30.5% in Q2 FY26.
